mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interest_rates (product_code, effective_date, annual_rate, tier_threshold_jpy) VALUES (#{ir.productCode}, #{ir.effectiveDate}, #{ir.annualRate}, #{ir.tierThresholdJpy})
